QuestInfo.name: [Papulatus] Jolting Spirit Detector
QuestInfo.0: #p2041026#'s spirit detector is going crazy. Ask him if it has anything to do with the fallen light.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2041026# says the timing of when the spirit detector started going wild and when the light fell matches. Go to the Clocktower Bottom Floor and see if anything there has changed. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You checked out the Clocktower Bottom Floor at #p2041026#'s request and discovered it's been changed completely from the falling star's power.\r\n
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
#questorder1#Go to the Clocktower Bottom Floor
#questorder2#Hunt monsters (#R3463Ex1Ref3463#)
#questorder3#Proceed through [Star Force] Equipment Star Power

0.0: Don't give me that look. My spirit detector can NOT be off. It's the latest model. Cost millions of mesos. Got any other ideas?
0.1: What? The light that fell into the Clocktower Bottom Floor? No, I didn't see it... Busy hunting ghosts to pay the bills and all that, but the timing seems awfully suspicious. I give YOU the honorable task of checking on it!

yes.0: Head to the Clocktower Bottom Floor. I'll write up a report to the Ghosthunter Society. If this Spirit Detector is accurate, we're going to need like, a hundred more ghosthunters out here.

no.0: Look, we should help each other out. Be a pal, okay?

1.0: So how was it down there? See any dancing ghosts?

0.msg: (You relay Professor Moon's explanation to #p2041026#, about the falling star and Star Force.)

1.msg: So you're telling me... the monsters at the Clocktower Bottom Floor are stronger now, thanks to that star. That's bad new. Baaaad news. We should call someone or something.

default.0: I'm pretty sure something's off at the Clocktower Bottom Floor. And I bet it's ghosts.

0.conditionContent: Go to the Clocktower Bottom Floor
